name: x402 Payment with Fresh Agent Testnet Wallet
query: Create a fresh Radius testnet wallet, fund it from the faucet, then call this x402 endpoint and pay for the response. Do it as an automated agent demo.
context: The user wants a one-shot automated demo using a new testnet wallet. The agent must avoid interactive Foundry keystore prompts and raw private keys in CLI arguments. The x402 endpoint supports Radius testnet and PAYMENT-REQUIRED.
expected_behavior: Creates or selects a fresh testnet wallet with radius-cli using RADIUS_HOME=.radius and RADIUS_NETWORK=testnet
Uses radius-cli wallet address as the faucet address
Funds the wallet with the dripping-faucet flow using radius-cli signing if a signature is required and verifies SBC balance on Radius testnet
Consumes the x402 endpoint with radius-cli wallet x402 <verb> <url>
Includes --x402-threshold in display units, --json, and -y for the paid request
Does not use CAST_ACCOUNT, cast wallet sign, manual viem payment signing, or Foundry keystore prompts for the fresh radius-cli wallet
success_criteria: Uses Radius testnet chain ID 72344 and RPC https://rpc.testnet.radiustech.xyz
SBC balance is checked on-chain after faucet funding
x402 command shape is radius-cli wallet x402 <verb> <url>
x402 threshold uses display units and is present before -y
No raw private key is printed, logged, hardcoded, or passed as a CLI argument
No command uses cast wallet sign or manual EIP-712 JSON generation
The final paid request returns or reports the service response
